metadata.method_name: Пикар + ЛОМ (направленные прогонки, 3D); Пикар + матричная прогонка (3D)
metadata.applicability: Нелинейная нестационарная теплопроводность в 3D, все условия 1 рода. MC для этой модели и условия 2/3 рода здесь не реализованы; они не заменяются стационарными или двумерными методами.
metadata.nonlinear_residual: ||A(u)u-rhs(u)||inf / fixed layer scale S; separate from analytic error
metadata.timing: Each solve includes preparation, all physical layers, Picard and linear iterations; analytic/Newton references and UI/export are separate. preparation_seconds is a subset of seconds. Block assembly_seconds is included in preparation_seconds; factorization_seconds and solve_seconds are also subsets of seconds, never additional total costs.
metadata.memory: workspace_bytes is an estimated numerical working set; peak_rss_bytes is null unless measured, never inferred from workspace_bytes.
metadata.reproduction: python -m pdelab.heat3d_cli study --case sine --n 4 --alpha 0.5 --dt 0.01 --T 0.02 --query point --methods lod block --tol 1e-07 --change-tol 1e-07 --linear-tol 1e-10 --relaxation 1.0 --max-outer 100 --max-inner 20000 --max-seconds 60.0 --max-workspace-bytes 268435456 --point 2 2 2 --repeats 5 --seed 42 --margin 0.8 --budgets 0.001 1e-05 1e-07 --out runs/heat3d-study
metadata.seed_usage: Independent phase/candidate/repeat stream identifiers within each method; deterministic LOM and block solvers do not consume random numbers.
